title: Uncovering the mechanism of DCLK3 in colorectal cancer progression through WGCNA and machine learning.
authors: Yang, Lu; Han, Yanru; Ji, Juanjuan; Wang, Yuyu; Yang, Fang; Li, Wenjing; Guo, Xiaohe
one_liner_zh: 该文通过WGCNA和机器学习识别结直肠癌核心基因DCLK3，并实验验证转录因子ELK1对其转录激活，虽涉及TF-DNA调控但以湿实验为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟建模方法，与课题方法轴匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a prevalent malignant tumor of the digestive tract with high morbidity and mortality rates. Although doublecortin like kinase 3 (DCLK3) is upregulated in CRC and promotes disease progression, its specific mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: Core factors of CRC were identified through bioinformatics analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), and machine learning algorithms. The expression level of DCLK3 and ELK1 were evaluated using bioinformatics databases (GSE142279, The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA)) and experimental validation (quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR), Western blot). Functional assays (3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide (MTT) assay, flow cytometry, Transwell assay, wound healing assay, sphere formation assay, tube formation assay, in vivo model, hematoxylin and eosin staining (HE), and immunohistochemistry (IHC)) and mechanism studies (prediction via Genecards and JASPAR databases, dual-luciferase reporter assay, and chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP)) were performed to validate and explore the molecular mechanism of DCLK3 in CRC. RESULTS: Bioinformatics analysis combined with WGCNA and machine learning algorithms identified DCLK3 as a core gene. DCLK3 was significantly upregulated in CRC, and its high expression was associated with poorer overall survival in patients. Knockdown of DCLK3 inhibited the proliferation of CRC cells, promoted apoptosis, and suppressed cell invasion, migration, cancer stemness, and angiogenesis. ETS like-1 protein (ELK1) promoted malignant phenotypes in CRC cells by transcriptionally activating DCLK3. Also, in vivo studies demonstrated that ELK1 activated DCLK3 to facilitate CRC tumor growth. CONCLUSION: DCLK3, identified through bioinformatic analysis, promotes CRC progression via its transcriptional activation by the transcription factor ELK1, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是一种常见的消化道恶性肿瘤，具有较高的发病率和死亡率。尽管双皮质素样激酶3（DCLK3）在CRC中表达上调并促进疾病进展，但其具体机制仍不清楚。方法：通过生物信息学分析、加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和机器学习算法识别CRC的核心因子。利用生物信息学数据库（GSE142279、癌症基因组图谱（TCGA））和实验验证（实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）、Western blot）评估DCLK3和ELK1的表达水平。通过功能实验（3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物（MTT）实验、流式细胞术、Transwell实验、伤口愈合实验、成球实验、管形成实验、体内模型、苏木精-伊红染色（HE）和免疫组织化学（IHC））以及机制研究（通过Genecards和JASPAR数据库预测、双荧光素酶报告基因实验和染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP））来验证和探索DCLK3在CRC中的分子机制。结果：结合生物信息学分析、WGCNA和机器学习算法，将DCLK3识别为核心基因。DCLK3在CRC中显著上调，其高表达与患者较差的总生存期相关。敲低DCLK3抑制了CRC细胞的增殖，促进凋亡，并抑制细胞侵袭、迁移、癌症干性和血管生成。ETS样-1蛋白（ELK1）通过转录激活DCLK3促进CRC细胞的恶性表型。此外，体内研究表明，ELK1激活DCLK3以促进CRC肿瘤生长。结论：通过生物信息学分析识别的DCLK3，经由转录因子ELK1的转录激活促进CRC进展，凸显其作为治疗靶点的潜力。
